title: Dynamics 365 Business Central license keys: what changes from version 28.
summary: Starting October 1, 2026, Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises and Dual Use Rights licenses no longer use version-specific keys. Instead, a single '28+' key family applies to all versions 28 and later, requiring administrators to download a refreshed license file before each version upgrade to unlock new objects.
key_points: Version-specific license keys are discontinued; '28+' is the unified key for all on-premises editions and DUR licenses
A fresh 28+ key must be downloaded before upgrading to each new version, with the download date determining which objects unlock
Dual Use Rights deployments have a separate six-month key renewal requirement independent of the 28+ upgrade rule
Administrators must add license key download to upgrade checklists and track DUR key expiry dates

quotes.text: new releases of Dynamics 36 Business Central no longer include version-specific license keys for on-premises
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the fundamental change in licensing strategy that affects all on-premises deployments starting October 1, 2026

quotes.text: you must download a refreshed 28+ key if you want to upgrade to the latest version
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the new mandatory step in every upgrade process and the ongoing operational burden
